## Idea

A {{#concept "subtractive ideal generated by a family of elements" Disambiguation="semiring" Agda=subtractive-ideal-family-of-elements-Semiring}} `(xᵢ)ᵢ` of a [semiring](ring-theory.semirings.md) `R` is the [subtractive ideal generated by the subset](ring-theory.subtractive-ideals-generated-by-subsets-semirings.lagda.md) of all the elements of the form `xᵢ` for some `i` in the indexing type of `(xᵢ)ᵢ`. In other words, the subtractive ideal generated by `(xᵢ)ᵢ` is the least [subtractive ideal](ring-theory.subtractive-ideals-semirings.md) that contains all the elements `xᵢ`. In informal writing, the subtractive ideal generated by the family of elements `(xᵢ)ᵢ` is denoted by `⟨xᵢ⟩ˢ`.

## Definitions

### The predicate of being a subtractive ideal generated by a family of elements

```agda
module _
  {l1 l2 l3 : Level} (R : Semiring l1) {I : UU l2} (x : I → type-Semiring R)
  (J : subtractive-ideal-Semiring l3 R)
  where

  is-subtractive-ideal-generated-by-family-of-elements-Semiring : UUω
  is-subtractive-ideal-generated-by-family-of-elements-Semiring =
    {l4 : Level} (K : subtractive-ideal-Semiring l4 R) →
    leq-subtractive-ideal-Semiring R J K ↔
    ((i : I) → is-in-subtractive-ideal-Semiring R K (x i))

  contains-element-is-subtractive-ideal-generated-by-family-of-elements-Semiring :
    is-subtractive-ideal-generated-by-family-of-elements-Semiring →
    (i : I) → is-in-subtractive-ideal-Semiring R J (x i)
  contains-element-is-subtractive-ideal-generated-by-family-of-elements-Semiring
    U =
    forward-implication (U J) (refl-leq-subtractive-ideal-Semiring R J)

  leq-is-subtractive-ideal-generated-by-family-of-elements-Semiring :
    is-subtractive-ideal-generated-by-family-of-elements-Semiring →
    {l4 : Level} (K : subtractive-ideal-Semiring l4 R)
    (k : (i : I) → is-in-subtractive-ideal-Semiring R K (x i)) →
    leq-subtractive-ideal-Semiring R J K
  leq-is-subtractive-ideal-generated-by-family-of-elements-Semiring U K =
    backward-implication (U K)
```

## Properties

### Any two subtractive ideals generated by the same family of elements contain the same elements

```agda
module _
  {l1 l2 l3 l4 : Level} (R : Semiring l1) {I : UU l2} (x : I → type-Semiring R)
  (J : subtractive-ideal-Semiring l3 R)
  (U : is-subtractive-ideal-generated-by-family-of-elements-Semiring R x J)
  (K : subtractive-ideal-Semiring l4 R)
  (V : is-subtractive-ideal-generated-by-family-of-elements-Semiring R x K)
  where

  has-same-elements-is-subtractive-ideal-generated-by-family-of-elements-Semiring :
    has-same-elements-subtractive-ideal-Semiring R J K
  pr1
    ( has-same-elements-is-subtractive-ideal-generated-by-family-of-elements-Semiring
      r) =
    leq-is-subtractive-ideal-generated-by-family-of-elements-Semiring R x J U K
      ( contains-element-is-subtractive-ideal-generated-by-family-of-elements-Semiring
        R x K V)
      ( r)
  pr2
    ( has-same-elements-is-subtractive-ideal-generated-by-family-of-elements-Semiring
      r) =
    leq-is-subtractive-ideal-generated-by-family-of-elements-Semiring R x K V J
      ( contains-element-is-subtractive-ideal-generated-by-family-of-elements-Semiring
        R x J U)
      ( r)
```

### Any subtractive ideal that has the same elements as the ideal generated by a family of elements `x` satisfies the universal property of the subtractive ideal generated by the family of elements `x`

```agda
module _
  {l1 l2 l3 : Level} (R : Semiring l1) {I : UU l2} (x : I → type-Semiring R)
  (J : subtractive-ideal-Semiring l3 R)
  where

  is-subtractive-ideal-generated-by-family-of-elements-has-same-elements-Semiring :
    has-same-elements-subtractive-ideal-Semiring R
      ( subtractive-ideal-family-of-elements-Semiring R x)
      ( J) →
    is-subtractive-ideal-generated-by-family-of-elements-Semiring R x J
  is-subtractive-ideal-generated-by-family-of-elements-has-same-elements-Semiring
    H K =
    logical-equivalence-reasoning
      leq-subtractive-ideal-Semiring R J K
      ↔ leq-subtractive-ideal-Semiring R
          ( subtractive-ideal-family-of-elements-Semiring R x)
          ( K)
        by
        iff-Π-iff-family
          ( λ y →
            ( λ f → f ∘ forward-implication (H y)) ,
            ( λ f → f ∘ backward-implication (H y)))
      ↔ ((i : I) → is-in-subtractive-ideal-Semiring R K (x i))
        by
        is-subtractive-ideal-generated-by-family-of-elements-subtractive-ideal-family-of-elements-Semiring
          R x K
```

### The subtractive ideal `⟨xᵢ⟩ˢ` is trivial if and only if `zero-Semiring R ＝ xᵢ` for every `i`

```agda
module _
  {l1 l2 : Level} (R : Semiring l1) {I : UU l2} (x : I → type-Semiring R)
  where

  is-trivial-subtractive-ideal-family-of-elements-Semiring :
    ((i : I) → is-zero-Semiring R (x i)) →
    is-trivial-ideal-Semiring R
      ( ideal-subtractive-ideal-family-of-elements-Semiring R x)
  is-trivial-subtractive-ideal-family-of-elements-Semiring H =
    is-trivial-subtractive-closure-ideal-Semiring R
      ( ideal-family-of-elements-Semiring R x)
      ( is-trivial-ideal-family-of-elements-Semiring R x H)

  is-family-of-zeroes-is-trivial-subtractive-ideal-family-of-elements-Semiring :
    is-trivial-ideal-Semiring R
      ( ideal-subtractive-ideal-family-of-elements-Semiring R x) →
    (i : I) → is-zero-Semiring R (x i)
  is-family-of-zeroes-is-trivial-subtractive-ideal-family-of-elements-Semiring
    H i =
    H (contains-elements-subtractive-ideal-family-of-elements-Semiring R x i)
```

### For any map `f : J → I` and any family of elements `x : I → R`, the subtractive ideal `⟨x ∘ f⟩ˢ` is contained in the subtractive ideal `⟨x⟩ˢ`

```agda
module _
  {l1 l2 l3 : Level} (R : Semiring l1) {I : UU l2} {J : UU l3}
  (x : I → type-Semiring R) (f : J → I)
  where

  inclusion-precomp-subtractive-ideal-family-of-elements-Semiring :
    leq-subtractive-ideal-Semiring R
      ( subtractive-ideal-family-of-elements-Semiring R (x ∘ f))
      ( subtractive-ideal-family-of-elements-Semiring R x)
  inclusion-precomp-subtractive-ideal-family-of-elements-Semiring =
    preserves-order-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring R
      ( subtype-im (x ∘ f))
      ( subtype-im x)
      ( inclusion-precomp-im x f)

module _
  {l1 l2 l3 : Level} (R : Semiring l1) {I : UU l2} {J : UU l3}
  (y : J → type-Semiring R) (x : I → type-Semiring R) (f : J → I)
  (H : coherence-triangle-maps y x f)
  where

  inclusion-coherence-triangle-subtractive-ideal-family-of-elements-Semiring :
    leq-subtractive-ideal-Semiring R
      ( subtractive-ideal-family-of-elements-Semiring R y)
      ( subtractive-ideal-family-of-elements-Semiring R x)
  inclusion-coherence-triangle-subtractive-ideal-family-of-elements-Semiring =
    preserves-order-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring R
      ( subtype-im y)
      ( subtype-im x)
      ( inclusion-coherence-triangle-im y x f H)
```
